Your voice. Your research. Your craft.

A focused sanctuary for your manuscript.
Precision in rhythm, fidelity in research.

Sense where a chapter breathes or stumbles. Trace every scene detail and historical fact back to its verified source. Curate standalone reading copies with precisely the context your editors or readers need. Lixity unites immersive reading, living research dossiers, and transparent linguistic resonance in a private, local-first studio for authors.

Meet Lixity ↓ Try a passage in browser →

Fictional English manuscript. Interactive read-only demo. No account or upload required.

From initial spark to polished prose.

Close reading, evidence and chapter comparisons stay connected to the text. Built-in analysis runs offline; optional speech and research services are configured separately. The CLI and Python API reuse the same analysis engine.

Available in v0.8.0: full offline analysis, Direct Speech Mode, manuscript reader, research dossiers, and standalone reading copies. The integrated editor is also ready in the current checkout.

Distraction-free writing. Grounded close reading.

Immerse yourself in clean typography, set tactile review markers, and explore sentence cadences in context. The integrated editor pairs focused drafting with local autosave, robust conflict protection, and an uninterrupted undo history—transitioning seamlessly between creation and reflection.

Editor scope and availability (English)

Listen to the pulse and melody of your prose.

Spot sticky sentences, dialogue-tag density, scene entry/exit hooks, POV chapter gaps, and voice separation between narration and dialogue. Compare against optional non-prescriptive genre corridors or stay 100% self-calibrated—every metric links back to exact words in your text, offline and without generative AI.

Text-analysis workflow (English)

Research with memory and provenance.

Anchor manuscript passages directly to primary sources, thematic dossiers, and narrative decisions. Immutable revisions preserve the evidence behind every detail—keeping historical accuracy, geographical cues, and character motives grounded.

Take a short tour

Curated reading editions and print copies.

Generate beautiful book PDFs, standalone offline companion websites, or focused proof copies for beta readers. No cloud tracking, zero external lock-in: your creative project remains completely yours.

Reading copy (English)
“

Evidence over interference: the author commands.

Lixity offers nuanced linguistic mirrors, never artistic dogma. It does not grade literary merit or rewrite your sentences with automated prose. It gives you the clarity to sculpt your own voice and fulfill your vision on your own terms.

Bring your own text.

Install Lixity locally on Windows, macOS or Linux. Start with Markdown or plain text and follow the installation guide.

Installation guide (English)
uv tool install --python 3.12 --managed-python lixity

Install the current v0.8.0 release locally in seconds; optional speech and research services stay strictly separated.

Website measurement (English)

This public website uses GoatCounter to count page visits and named demo, installation, repository and PDF links. The adapter sends public page paths and event names, excluding query strings, fragments, form contents and manuscript selections. The local app and exported manuscript reports contain no such measurement.

Language and appearance choices are stored locally in this browser when storage is available. Browser language is used only to suggest a public introduction; it is not sent to a translation service or used to change manuscript analysis.

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control disable collection. Counts are approximate and do not establish installations or active authors. GoatCounter receives technical request data; see its privacy information. For questions, use the contact below.
